rows.question: why is my circuit not getting any gain
rows.answer:
The signal path is broken: R1's left pin isn't wired to anything (LTspice named it NC_01) and V1's Vin node has only that one connection. So the source is completely disconnected from the RC network - Vout sits at 0 for all frequencies, i.e. no output at all.

Fix: wire the dangling pin of R1 to the Vin node (V1's + terminal). Then you get the intended divider/low-pass: R1 in series, C1 and R2 to ground.

Note once it's connected, R2 (15k to ground) will hold the passband gain to 15k/(10k+15k) = 0.6, not unity - remove it if you wanted a plain RC low-pass.
